claim.claim-text: 1. A method for adaptive utilization of a ball-throwing machine in conjunction with a media player, the method comprising:
2. The method of claim 1, further comprising: recording an indication of the first training program in a player profile.
3. The method of claim 1 or claim 2, further comprising: recording training data indicating metrics associated with performance of the first training program.
4. The method of claim 3, wherein the training data includes a number of the one or more balls delivered and a trajectory of each of the one or more balls delivered.

5. The method of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the first training program includes an indication of movements to be performed by the first player upon receipt of the first ball of the one or more balls.

6. The method of claim 5, further comprising: performing, by the control logic, an analysis of the image data resulting in detection of movements of the first player, and a determination as to whether movements of the first player correspond to the indication of movements to be performed by the first player included in the first training program.

7. The method of any one of the preceding claims, further comprising: performing, by the control logic, a second analysis of the image data resulting in determination of a speed of movements of the first player.
9. The system of claim 8, further comprising: recording an indication of the first training program in a player profile.
10. The system of claim 8 or claim 9, further comprising: recording training data indicating metrics associated with performance of the first training program.
11. The system of claim 10, wherein the training data includes a number of the one or more balls delivered and a trajectory of each of the one or more balls delivered.

12. The system of any one of claims 8 to 11, wherein the first training program includes an indication of movements to be performed by the first player upon receipt of the first ball of the one or more balls.

13. The system of claim 12, further comprising: performing, by the control logic, an analysis of the image data resulting in detection of movements of the first player, and a determination as to whether movements of the first player correspond to the indication of movements to be performed by the first player included in the first training program.

14. The system of any one of claims 8 to 13, further comprising: performing, by the control logic, a second analysis of the image data resulting in determination of a speed of movements of the first player.

15. A non-transitory, computer-readable storage medium having stored thereon instructions that, when executed by a processing device, cause performance of operations according to any one of claims 1 to 7.
